slides.title_en: I’m York Cheng, a director from Taiwan.
slides.copy_zh: 這九頁，是我怎麼拍一支廣告的快速版本。
slides.copy_en: Nine pages on how I approach a commercial film.
slides.alt_zh: 鄭又勛 York Cheng 肖像

slides.title_en: One pot of tea undoes a siege.
slides.copy_zh: 我先讓刀光和走位把客棧逼緊。大茶壺一上桌，敵我坐成一桌，產品也把結局改了。
slides.copy_en: I let blades and movement tighten the inn first. When the oversized teapot lands, both sides sit together—and the product changes the ending.
slides.alt_zh: 茶裏王客棧中武俠人物圍坐喝茶
slides.alt_en: Wuxia characters gather around tea in the Tea’s Tea inn

slides.title_zh: 我讓它先像婚禮，再慢慢露出鬼片的樣子。
slides.title_en: I let the wedding slowly reveal its ghost story.
slides.copy_zh: 拜堂、紅妝都先照熟悉的儀式走。等新娘回魂，那些原本好看的東西才一起變得不對勁。
slides.copy_en: The bows and red bridal makeup follow familiar rituals at first. When the bride returns from the dead, everything that looked beautiful starts to feel wrong.
slides.alt_zh: 最後的道長中紅妝新娘的恐怖畫面
slides.alt_en: Red-bridal horror scene from The Last Taoist

slides.eyebrow: MARTIAL ARTS DIRECTION / 武打導演
slides.context_zh: 霸王之野望 × 御劍神州 × 煙雨江湖
slides.context_en: Bawang no Bou × Yujian Shenzhou × Misty River
slides.title_en: I know how to make a fight read.
slides.copy_zh: 我在意的不是招式多，而是觀眾能不能跟上。近身出手、群戰走位、出劍帶水花，我都把起點和結果留在畫面裡。
slides.copy_en: What matters to me is whether the audience can follow the action. Close-range strikes, ensemble combat and a sword stroke kicking up water all keep the setup and result visible.
slides.alt_zh: 武俠角色在森林中持劍交鋒
slides.alt_en: Martial artists cross swords in a forest

slides.eyebrow: LIVE ACTION × VFX / 真人 × 特效
slides.context_zh: 斗羅大陸 × 不休的烏拉拉 × 神魔傳說
slides.title_zh: 拍特效，演員先看對地方。
slides.title_en: For VFX, the actors need a real point to see.
slides.copy_zh: 斗羅用手勢帶出能量；烏拉拉讓巨龍闖進日常；神魔從白袍走到黑袍。視線、動作和場景先對上，特效才進得來。
slides.copy_en: In Soul Land, gestures lead the energy; Ulala brings a dragon into daily life; Shenmo moves from white robes to black. When performance and space agree, the effects can enter the scene.
slides.alt_zh: 真人演員與奇幻特效共構的戰鬥場面
slides.alt_en: Live-action performance integrated with fantasy visual effects

slides.title_en: I start with the people who came this close.
slides.copy_zh: 先讓每個演員演出那一下懊惱，再讓群像把挫折接下去。等大家都懂「就差一點」，補點才有理由出現。
slides.copy_en: Each actor plays that flash of frustration, and the ensemble carries it forward. Once everyone understands “so close,” Google Play’s top-up has a reason to appear.
slides.alt_zh: Google Play 廣告中多人對著遊戲螢幕的表演
slides.alt_en: Ensemble performance around a game screen in Google Play’s film

slides.title_zh: 刀頭真的碰到臉，規格才會有感覺。
slides.title_en: A feature only feels real when the razor meets the face.
slides.copy_zh: 我讓藍光沿著臉頰走，再把貼臉表演和刀頭特寫接在一起。「磁浮」這兩個字，才有了一個看得見的動作。
slides.copy_en: I let the blue light travel along the cheek, pairing the facial performance with close product detail. “Magnetic suspension” becomes a movement the audience can actually see.
slides.alt_zh: 舒適牌 HydroPRO 刮鬍刀與藍光產品特寫
slides.alt_en: Schick HydroPRO razor product detail with blue light

slides.eyebrow: AI × LIVE ACTION BRAND FILM / AI × 實拍品牌影像
slides.context_zh: 王品肉次方｜肉道三部曲
slides.context_en: ROU CI FANG — The Way of Meat Trilogy
slides.title_en: I turn the same cut into three moves.
slides.copy_zh: 壹之型立武館，貳之型把刀法變成符號，參之型收進人物關係。三支片共用一個世界，各有自己的打法。
slides.copy_en: Form I establishes the dojo, Form II makes the cut a symbol, and Form III turns to character relationships. They share one world, but each moves differently.
slides.alt_zh: 肉次方武館與現切原塊肉的混合影像
slides.alt_en: AI/CG dojo and live-action meat cutting for ROU CI FANG

slides.title_zh: 有一支片想拍，歡迎找我聊。
slides.title_en: Have a film in mind? Let’s talk.
slides.copy_zh: 鄭又勛｜類型敘事廣告導演

director.tagline_zh: 遊戲廣告 · 商業影像 · 真人實拍 · CG · AI 影像
director.tagline_en: Game Advertising · Commercial Film · Live Action · CG · AI Film
director.point_of_view_zh: 我通常先找一個自己會想看下去的畫面，再回頭想：人物怎麼站得住，產品又要怎麼走進他的選擇裡。
director.point_of_view_en: I usually begin with an image I would want to keep watching, then work backwards: what makes the character feel real, and where can the product enter that choice naturally?
director.bio_zh: 我是鄭又勛，台灣導演，主要拍遊戲廣告與商業影像。真人、CG 或 AI 的形式可以變，但我在意的事情差不多：角色先站得住，產品才有地方進來。
director.bio_en: I'm York Cheng, a Taiwan-based director working mainly in game advertising and commercial film. The format may shift between live action, CG and AI, but the question stays the same: make the character feel real, then find a natural place for the product.

contact.location_zh: 台灣 · 可洽跨市場合作

works.copy_zh: 一句「夠嗎？」先是武俠挑釁，最後變成這壺茶夠不夠大家喝。
works.copy_en: “Is that enough?” begins as a wuxia challenge and ends as a question about sharing tea.

works.copy_zh: 三個問句，把權力、愛情與兄弟留在林志穎的三杯酒裡。
works.copy_en: Three questions leave power, love and brotherhood in Jimmy Lin’s three cups.

works.copy_zh: 徐若瑄從戰場白袍走到白骨王座，成魔不是片尾造型，是一段完整轉變。
works.copy_en: Vivian Hsu moves from white robes on the battlefield to black on the bone throne; the demon is a full transformation, not a final look.

works.copy_zh: 不拍抓鬼，讓拜堂字卡一張張數到新娘回魂。
works.copy_en: Do not chase the ghost; let each wedding card count down to the bride’s return.

works.copy_zh: 蒙眼不是裝飾。變身前後兩位劍客都遮住雙眼，最後一句「我看得見」，才把看不見翻成武功。
works.copy_en: The blindfold is not decoration. Both swordsmen enter the transformation unable to see; “I can see” lands only after blindness has become the skill.

works.title_en: ROU CI FANG — The Way of Meat
works.copy_zh: 現切原塊肉，也有肉道黑帶的三型招式。
works.copy_en: Cutting whole meat to order becomes a three-form, black-belt discipline.

works.title_zh: 舒適牌 HydroPRO 磁浮刮鬍刀
works.copy_zh: 純黑舞台只留一圈冷藍，讓磁浮在刀頭貼上臉頰時被看見。
works.copy_en: Against pure black, one cold-blue ring makes magnetic suspension visible as the razor meets the cheek.

works.title_zh: Google Play 台灣《就差一點》
works.copy_zh: 先拍玩家那口不甘心，再讓 Google Play Points 補上少掉的一「點」。
works.copy_en: Start with the player’s frustration, then let Google Play Points supply the missing “point.”

works.copy_zh: 每次落子都展開一段戰功；兜帽揭開後，才知道這局一直在和自己下。
works.copy_en: Each move opens a campaign; when the hood comes off, we learn that he has been playing against himself all along.

works.title_en: Soul Land: World of Soul Hunters
works.copy_zh: 《終極一班》班底不回頭，在真實校園裡換一種武魂再成軍。
works.copy_en: The KO One cast forms up again, this time with martial souls inside a real campus.

works.copy_zh: 任家萱與任容萱隔著古今彼此照應，片尾再以分割畫面並排留在兩個房間。
works.copy_en: Across past and present, mirrors and window frames keep the sisters connected before a split screen places them side by side in two rooms.

works.copy_zh: 我先把明星臉拿掉，只留紅燭、黑甲和血月。七個職業亮相後，觀眾才被拉進選擇。
works.copy_en: I hide the celebrity face behind red candles, black armor and a blood moon. Only after seven classes appear does the viewer enter the choice.

works.copy_zh: 從黑色晚禮服到赤壁紅袍，遠古召喚把林心如的前世叫醒。
works.copy_en: From a black evening gown to red robes at Red Cliffs, an ancient call wakes Ruby Lin’s past life.

works.copy_zh: 凌煙以扇作兵，桃花出劍帶起水花。兩支十五秒，各替一位紅顏留下一小段傳記。
works.copy_en: Ling Yan turns a fan into a weapon; Taohua’s sword throws water into the air. Two fifteen-second films leave each woman a short chapter of her own.

works.copy_zh: 冰龍與雷電先立起「天」，最後一劍才完成「開」。
works.copy_en: Ice and lightning build the “heaven”; the final sword strike completes the “opening.”

works.copy_zh: 一句「這些魔靈召喚都用送的」，把正經台語對峙推到百抽爆開。演員不先笑，笑點才留給觀眾。
works.copy_en: A dead-serious Taiwanese standoff lands on “all these summons are free,” then bursts into a hundred-pull payoff. The cast never winks, so the laugh stays with the audience.

works.copy_zh: 巨龍從落地窗外找上門；少年舉起手機，下一秒全家已經變成遊戲隊伍。
works.copy_en: A dragon arrives outside the picture window; the boy raises his phone, and the whole family becomes the game party in the next beat.

works.copy_zh: 小紅帽帶回狼頭，白雪改問最強大；童話走到一半，受害者開始掌局。
works.copy_en: Red Riding Hood brings back the wolf’s head; Snow White asks for power. Halfway through, the victims take control.

works.copy_zh: 鰲拜的「我要」一路加成「我全都要」，片尾手機替整張集卡清單結帳。
works.copy_en: Oboi’s “I want it” grows into “I want it all,” and the final phone checks out the whole card-collection list.

works.copy_zh: 同一枚玉珮從今生喚回前世，再把千年等待收進一次回頭。
works.copy_en: One jade pendant calls back the past, then gathers a thousand-year wait into one final look.

works.copy_zh: 我沒有讓規格先出場。先拍花、氣球和那些容易被忽略的美，雙螢幕最後才像一件創作工具接進來。
works.copy_en: I kept the specifications off screen at first. Flowers, balloons and overlooked details lead the film; the dual screens arrive later as a tool for making those ideas tangible.

works.copy_zh: 一盒巧克力被放大成整座城市都要抬頭看的聖誕吊飾。貼地仰拍和藍金色，是為了把櫃上的商品拉成一座地標。
works.copy_en: A box of chocolate becomes a Christmas ornament large enough for the whole city to look up at. Low angles and a blue-gold palette turn a counter display into a landmark.

works.title_zh: 舒芙晶透煥亮 CC 刀
works.copy_zh: 四種保養成分沒有被拍成成分表，而是變成繞著刀頭走的透明氣泡。隔離網一出現，安心才成了看得見的東西。
works.copy_en: Four skincare ingredients become clear bubbles moving around the razor head instead of a list of claims. When the protective mesh appears, reassurance becomes something visible.

works.copy_zh: 紅、藍兩隊先各自蓄勢，光刃、火球和人影都成雙出現。最後拉開寬鏡，才看見他們一直在同一局裡。
works.copy_en: Red and blue sides gather separately as blades, fireballs and silhouettes appear in pairs. Only the final wide shot reveals that they have been inside the same match all along.

works.copy_zh: 獎盃先出現，接著才倒回去看選手怎麼走到那裡。火光、逆光和隊徽，把最後的並肩拍得像剛走完一場硬仗。
works.copy_en: The trophy appears first, then the film works backward through the road that led there. Fire, backlight and team crests make the final line-up feel earned.

works.copy_zh: 我最喜歡的是那個「一億戰力」的手機畫面。前面把街頭拍得像一場幫派資格審查，數字一亮，地位立刻翻過來。
works.copy_en: My favorite beat is the phone revealing a combat power of one hundred million. The street first plays like a gang initiation; one number reverses the entire pecking order.

works.copy_zh: 一顆撞色籃球，把停車場、潑漆和城市球場連成同一條弧線。田壘與高國豪不是站台，而是帶我們走進這個世界的人。
works.copy_en: One two-tone basketball connects a parking lot, splashes of paint and the city court in a single arc. The athletes are not endorsements placed on top; they are the way into the world.

works.copy_zh: 我想先保留啦啦隊原本明亮的青春感，再用一道紅光把她們換成武者。刀、弓、扇接上去，日常和江湖才真的合在一起。
works.copy_en: I wanted to keep the bright energy of the cheer squad before a red flash turns them into warriors. Sword, bow and fan complete the handoff from everyday life to the martial world.

works.copy_zh: 辦公室開場故意拍得很正經，視角卻一格一格往桌面、網襪和俯拍移。等權力關係翻過來，角色解鎖也成了那個笑點。
works.copy_en: The office begins with complete seriousness, while the camera shifts step by step to the desk, fishnets and an overhead view. Once the power dynamic flips, the character reveal lands as the joke.

works.copy_zh: 三種人生先躺在海灘上，接著被放大成天際線廣告，最後連鈔票都落回真實街道。選擇越誇張，反而越像玩家會相信的日常。
works.copy_en: Three possible lives begin side by side on a beach, expand into skyline billboards, then send money falling into the real street. The larger the fantasy becomes, the more believable the choice feels.

works.title_zh: 文明與征服／全球大戰篇
works.copy_zh: 大殿拍得越一本正經，吳宗憲那句「有誰不服？」就越好笑。這支片的喜劇沒有多做什麼，只把那一拍留準。
works.copy_en: The more seriously the great hall is played, the funnier Jacky Wu’s “Anyone disagree?” becomes. The comedy comes from doing less and holding that beat precisely.

gambling_commercials.copy_zh: 大型棚景、群戲調度、代言人表演與多場景轉換。
gambling_commercials.copy_en: Large-scale sets, ensemble direction, talent performance and multi-scene transitions.
